definitions: A type of electric bicycle designed for riding on unpaved roads and gravel paths, combining features of a gravel bike with an electric motor for assistance.
An e-bike specifically engineered for off-road adventures on varied loose terrain, offering power assistance.
examples: He bought a new gravel e-bike for his weekend trips.
The gravel e-bike made climbing hills much easier.
Many riders are choosing a gravel e-bike for its versatility.
